raw: {"analysis":"FJH provides a more rigorous and complete plan that correctly sequences local verification before CI, addresses the dual-approval requirement with proper independence, and includes practical handling of the flaky snapshot timeout. XDF has a critical sequencing flaw: it runs CI only after dual approval, meaning if CI fails, the approvals were wasted and re-approval is needed; it also confusingly references running local checks against a staging data mirror, which conflates the read-only staging constraint. FJH's cost-control logic (one CI run, manual restart on timeout, halt on diff failure) is more coherent and actionable.","verdict":"FJH"}
